summary: community.general 13 removed oracle_* doc fragments, pipx make_process_list, pushbullet, saslprep utils, sensu_* modules, spotinst_aws_elastigroup (use spot.cloud_modules) and typetalk.
questions: Were the sensu modules removed from community.general?

answer_card.title: community.general 13 removals (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `oracle_creatable_resource`, `oracle_display_name_option`, `oracle_name_option`, `oracle_tags`, `oracle_wait_options` doc fragments removed.
- pipx `make_process_list()` removed.
- `pushbullet`, `typetalk` removed.
- `saslprep` module utils removed.
- `sensu_check`, `sensu_client`, `sensu_handler`, `sensu_silence`, `sensu_subscription` removed.
- `spotinst_aws_elastigroup` removed; use **`spot.cloud_modules.aws_elastigroup`**.
